notes: Competency C-6fcd47f5: stand up a solver and train/test network definition for a training run. The agent authors a prototxt generator CLI plus the visible solver/train/test triple. The checker parses the generated prototxt and enforces: solver_mode CPU, max_iter clamped to the 1000 cap, net/test_net pointing at the generated nets inside the out-dir, positive base_lr/test_iter/test_interval, per-phase data layers whose source points into the given data root with the requested batch size, unique layer names, SoftmaxWithLoss (+Accuracy on test), byte-level determinism, and non-zero exit without artifacts on invalid arguments. Hidden cases exercise unseen data roots, batch 1 and 64, and max_iter above the cap.
